L2_selective_prediction_pays.gate: accuracy on answered > accuracy scoring everything
L2_selective_prediction_pays.HONEST_READING: HOLDS by the letter of the pre-registered gate, but the effect is NOT distinguishable from noise: the 95% bootstrap CI includes zero. Abstaining cost 25.7% of coverage and bought about 2.3 rows out of 292. Read this as 'abstention did not hurt', not as 'abstention helped'.

L3_blinding_is_physical.gate: adversarial leak column, once blinded, changes no parameter

L4_independence_gate_halts.gate: collapsed feature set produces zero predictions

L7_calibration_measured_not_gated.note: no gate. Published whatever it is.

honest_notes: The gates test GOVERNANCE properties, not predictive power. A perfectly governed learner can be a useless predictor; L7 exists to make that visible rather than deniable.
Blinding a column is not fairness. A blinded feature can be reconstructed from correlated ones and nothing here checks for that.
'archived' was blinded because it is a direct component of the outcome definition. Leaving it in would let the model read the answer.
